guidelines.scope: Gold is labelled ONLY from each sample's input_text (exactly what the model saw). Real information that exists in the raw label but was removed by the FIELDS whitelist goes in whitelist_gaps, never in gold.
guidelines.indications: Specific conditions or symptoms, lowercase short noun phrases. Exclude boilerplate ('condition listed above', 'as directed by physician') and cosmetic/marketing claims ('leaves the skin flawless').
guidelines.contraindications: Absolute prohibitions — whom the product must not be used on, and where or how it must not be applied. Usually in CONTRAINDICATIONS (Rx) / DO_NOT_USE. Exclude packaging, tamper seals, storage.
guidelines.cautions: Situations needing care or a doctor's advice before use (ASK_DOCTOR, WARNINGS, pregnancy/nursing advice).
guidelines.general_warnings: Standard warnings that apply to the product class rather than to any particular user or condition — 'for external use only', 'keep out of reach of children'. Exclude packaging, tamper seals, storage.
guidelines.stop_use_conditions: Events during use that mean the user should stop ('stop use if', 'discontinue if').
guidelines.dosage_form: One value from the DosageForm Literal, judged from administration text in input_text (schema rule: 'dissolve under the tongue' => pellet).
